effect: Arms a bomb counter: after a set number of bombs a flower power-up appears (GameFAQs: maximum bombs and fire and the remote primer, for that stage)
note: On the "Area n" screen of areas 1-4 (it follows the world select for area 1 and the password for the others), with bombs and fire both under 3 ($02:48D5, sequence $02:4983). Bombs to place (table $02:4943, areas 1-4): Forest 10/20/30/15, Ocean 20/30/40/15, Wind 20/30/30/15, Cloud 15/20/30/20, Evil 20/30/10/20. GameFAQs lists the code. Mesen (tools/pocket/test_flower.lua): typed on the Ocean 3 screen it arms the counter with 40 ($C35B = 1, $C35C = 40), and the flower is spawned ($02:680C) at the 40th bomb; Wind 3 arms 30, Ocean 2 30.
Held together ($00:032A, the held-pad byte $FF82 & $0F = $0F): back to the boot state ($C1A8 = 0). Mesen: held for 10 frames in Forest 1, the intro starts again.
